thread:
maya: quick heads-up — i'm going to push a terraform change that (a) tweaks the provisioner weighting for the inference pool and (b) renames a vault secret path we use for node-bootstrap. want a quick sanity check before i open the PR :eyes:

sam: thanks for the ping — can you paste the TF snippet you plan to apply? curious about the provisioner weight math and any rollout plan

maya: sure, snippet below. main change is moving from `weight = 100` to `weight = 70` for `inference-provisioner` and flipping the vault path from `secret/data/infra/node` -> `secret/data/infra/node-bootstrap`

```hcl
module "karpenter_provisioner" {
  source = ".../karpenter/provisioner"
  name   = "inference-provisioner"
  weight = 70
  taints = ["workload=inference:NoSchedule"]
}

resource "vault_generic_secret" "node_bootstrap" {
  path = "secret/data/infra/node-bootstrap"
  data_json = jsonencode({ tls_cert = var.tls_cert })
}
```

lin: two quick things to watch: (1) HPA target utilization for inference pods is 45% currently — dropping provisioner weight could increase pod startup latency if we also reduce buffer nodes, (2) the secret rename needs a vault-sync job update (we have a sync lambda that expects the old path)

alex: +1 on lin. also check `karpenter.k8s.aws/ttl-after-empty` annotation on the provisioner for scale-down aggression. if you reduce weight, make sure ttl isn't too low or we'll churn nodes under steady load

maya: good notes. current TTL is 15m. i was thinking 10m in the change to free idle GPUs faster — maybe that was too aggressive

ryan: 10m is likely too low for inference workloads with cold-start embed caches. i'd keep 15m and instead tweak burst capacity or allow an on-demand fallback pool. can we add a small on-demand provisioner with lower priority?

sam: about the secret rename — what does the sync lambda look for? i can update it in the same PR if it's a small change

maya: lambda checks vault path `secret/data/infra/node` and writes to ssm param "/infra/node/certs". i'll update the lambda and add a migration step. plan: 1) add new secret path 2) update sync lambda to read both paths (old+new) for 2 deploys 3) flip callers to new path 4) remove old path job after 1 week

infra-bot: deploy-lint: terraform fmt OK. tfsec: WARNING - check for hardcoded creds in `data_json`. run `tfsec --severity HIGH` before apply.

lin: FYI on VPA interactions — we've seen VPA recommend downsizes after scale-to-zero events; if you have VPA autoscaling policies for inference pods, ensure the HPA minReplicas remains >=1 during rollout or traffic windows. otherwise provisioner changes + VPA = weird oscillation

maya: noted, will pin HPA minReplicas=1 for rollout window. also adding a canary rollout: apply to staging inference pool first, monitor 4h, then prod

sam: can you drop the PR link here when ready? i'll review the TF and the lambda diff. if you want i can also run a quick chaos test in staging (short scale-down)

maya: will do. PR target branch `infra/scaleworkflows/provisioner-tune`. aiming to open in ~90m. thanks for the checks everyone :thumbsup:

ryan: one more: update runbook note about "node-bootstrap secret path" so oncall isn't surprised during rotation

maya: added to my TODOs, will update runbook in the PR description

alex: sounds good. ping me on review if you want a quick look at the ttl and nodePool fallback settings

maya: thanks — will ping.
